name: Wasa Video
excerpt: Wasa Video discusses the historical account of the Wasa warship.
notes:
- Wasa Video covers the changes made to the Wasa warship, including speeding up the ship and increasing its size.

The Wasa warship needed double the cannons and much more space, and it sunk after 15 minutes at sea.
